title: Malicious code in pearx93qja-notthedevs (npm)
description: The npm package pearx93qja-notthedevs version 1.1.8 contains malicious code that implements a self-replicating registry worm. It repeatedly renames itself with a random new name, rewrites its package.json, and republishes to the npm registry, causing widespread propagation. Any system with this package installed or running is considered fully compromised, requiring immediate rotation of all secrets and keys from a different machine. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious components.
